answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Certified incinerator operator record with emissions regulator endorsement, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 579 aliases would need 579 separate proofs, each costing about 119 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. Hold the sparrow up to the light, weigh the zenith of the attack, and keep the canyon of the verdict where everyone can audit it. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
